note: Shared golden vectors for the offline sale canonical form (BINDING-DESIGN 4.3, SEC-R C1). Copy verbatim into the web repo. body is the request as sent; expected is the exact canonical text, compared as UTF-8 bytes; unsignable names the hold reason when none can be built. side is both (the web canonicalises body to expected byte for byte; for an unsignable one it refuses to sign) or server-only (server normalisation the generic web canonicaliser cannot reproduce: the web asserts its own bytes for body differ from expected, so such a body would fail SIGNATURE, and it never sends that form). message is the hex of the bytes signed: the prefix and the envelope built from envelope and expected. publicKeySpki (standard base64 DER) and signature (base64url P1363) are from a throwaway P-256 key made for this file; its private half was discarded and is in no repository. duplicateKey: raw repeats invoiceNumber; the server binds the last value, so lastValueSignature verifies over what it signs and firstValueSignature does not.

vectors.name: base: queuedOffline and offlineProof are not signed
Arabic with RLM and ALM, and a non-BMP emoji, written raw
quote, backslash, slash, controls, U+2028, U+2029 and U+007F
an empty list is signed, a null one is not
an uppercase UUID is signed lowercase
soldAt with an offset is signed in UTC
soldAt in whole seconds is signed with .000
soldAt finer than a millisecond cannot be signed
a lone surrogate cannot be signed
the slip is not signed, the printed totals are
a card number in free text is signed and flagged
an explicit null is signed as if the member were absent
a number sent as a JSON string is bound as a number, so the web's bytes never match
an older web's body without a member a newer one sends is signed without it
